t: The Site Whisperer: Reimagining Web Crawling in the Age of AI
s: This technical journal explores building genuinely new AI applications by documenting the messy innovation process. It focuses on empowering local-first, understandable AI tools and enhancing local LLMs through efficient context delivery, inspired by challenges in web crawling and developer workflows.
sub: Developer's journal documenting AI innovation process
Local-first architecture: HTML+HTMX, SQLite, no cloud
Enhancing local LLM intelligence via efficient context priming
Critique of cloud-based AI indexing (Cursor AI example)
